_comment: Wan2.2 14B Image-to-Video (I2V), ComfyUI API format, dual high/low-noise MoE topology per the official native template 'video_wan2_2_14B_i2v'. MODE = FULL-QUALITY 20-step (switched 2026-06-18 for max fidelity: lightx2v LoRA nodes 51/52 REMOVED, ModelSamplingSD3 41<-37 / 42<-38, KSamplerAdvanced steps=20 split 10/10, cfg=3.5, shift=8.0). To revert to fast lightx2v 4-step: re-add the two LoraLoaderModelOnly nodes (51<-37,52<-38; 41<-51,42<-52) and set steps=4/cfg=1.0/shift=5.0/split-at-2. Placeholders injected by the pipeline: {{REF_IMAGE}}(start-frame filename in ComfyUI input/) {{POS_PROMPT}} {{NEG_PROMPT}} {{FRAMES}}->length {{FPS}}->VHS frame_rate {{SEED}} {{WIDTH}} {{HEIGHT}}. NOTE: WanImageToVideo has no fps input; native frame rate is fixed by the model (~16fps), so {{FPS}} only drives the muxed mp4 frame_rate. CHAIN: UNETLoader(high) -> LoraLoaderModelOnly(high lightx2v) -> ModelSamplingSD3(shift 5) -> KSamplerAdvanced #47 (high-noise expert, steps 0->2); UNETLoader(low) -> LoraLoaderModelOnly(low lightx2v) -> ModelSamplingSD3(shift 5) -> KSamplerAdvanced #48 (low-noise expert, steps 2->end); CLIPLoader(wan,umt5) -> 2x CLIPTextEncode; VAELoader -> WanImageToVideo(+LoadImage start frame) -> VAEDecode -> VHS_VideoCombine(mp4). LIGHTX2V 4-STEP SETTINGS (verified, lightx2v model card discussion): total steps=4 split 2(high)+2(low), cfg=1.0, sampler=euler, scheduler=simple, ModelSamplingSD3 shift=5.0, LoRA strength=1.0. REQUIRED MODELS (exact filenames, all installed): diffusion_models/wan2.2_i2v_high_noise_14B_fp8_scaled.safetensors + wan2.2_i2v_low_noise_14B_fp8_scaled.safetensors ; loras/wan2.2_i2v_lightx2v_4steps_lora_v1_high_noise.safetensors + ..._low_noise.safetensors ; text_encoders/umt5_xxl_fp8_e4m3fn_scaled.safetensors ; vae/wan_2.1_vae.safetensors. REQUIRED CUSTOM NODES: ComfyUI-VideoHelperSuite (VHS_VideoCombine). Everything else is ComfyUI core. FULL-QUALITY TOGGLE (slower, higher fidelity): (1) bypass/remove the two LoraLoaderModelOnly nodes 51 & 52 and rewire ModelSamplingSD3 41<-37 and 42<-38 (straight from the UNETLoaders); (2) set both KSamplerAdvanced steps=20 with the split at 10 (node47 end_at_step=10, node48 start_at_step=10), cfg=3.5; (3) optionally raise ModelSamplingSD3 shift to 8.0. VRAM: 2x RTX 4090 48GB -> 480x832 is the fast zone and 720x1280 is fine; bump {{WIDTH}}/{{HEIGHT}} via config (video.gen_width/gen_height).
